projects.title: New Room Renovation Project
projects.bodyText:
- Handled the preparation, design, and installation of internet equipment and cabling, sound systems, and CCTV—totaling over 20 units—for a new room renovation project, achieving 100% success without any issues.
 - Perform cable management, bandwidth testing, and periodic hardware maintenance.

projects.title: Network Infrastructure Management
projects.bodyText:
- Overseen the deployment, configuration, and asset lifecycle of core network hardware.
 - Performed continuous preventive maintenance to maximize uptime and operational stability.
 - Troubleshot and resolved complex network infrastructure incidents with minimal downtime.

projects.title: PC Systems & Hardware Maintenance
projects.bodyText:
- Configured, deployed, and managed workstation inventory and peripheral hardware assets across operational units.
 - Performed routine preventive maintenance, system upgrades, and OS patching to maintain optimal computing performance.
 - Diagnosed and repaired PC hardware faults, operating system issues, and software errors with minimal downtime.

projects.title: CCTV & Surveillance System Infrastructure
projects.bodyText:
- Executed end-to-end installation and configuration of IP/Analog CCTV cameras, NVR/DVR recorders, and optimized network cabling routes.
 - Performed routine hardware inspections, lens calibrations, and storage capacity checks to ensure uninterrupted 24/7 surveillance recording.
 - Diagnosed and resolved video feed dropouts, signal loss, network connectivity faults, and power supply issues with minimal downtime.

projects.title: Internal Web Services & Domain Routing
projects.bodyText:
- Developed a streamlined web utility to simplify, generate, and standardize HTML email signatures across organization staff.
 - Configured and mapped the Power Pro Hotel management web system from a raw public IP address to a custom branded domain name for better accessibility.
 - Administered DNS records and web server configurations to ensure secure, reliable, and user-friendly web access for operational teams.

projects.title: Hotel Management System Support & User Assistance
projects.bodyText:
- Provided dedicated IT support to hotel staff, assisting with daily operations, module navigation, and workflow execution within the Power Pro Hotel Management System.
 - Troubleshot application glitches, data entry discrepancies, and operational issues promptly to maintain uninterrupted front-office and back-office services.

projects.title: RFID Access Door Integration & Hardware Repair
projects.bodyText:
- Configured and deployed OnIndo RFID access card systems across hotel guest rooms and restricted operational doors to ensure secure access control.
 - Diagnosed, repaired, and recalibrated malfunctioning electronic door locks, card readers, and power controller modules to restore functionality.
 - Programmed access credentials and conducted end-to-end testing to maintain seamless guest entry and physical security standards.

projects.title: Remote IT Helpdesk & Desktop Support
projects.bodyText:
- Provided prompt remote assistance to staff using remote desktop applications (e.g., AnyDesk, TeamViewer, VNC) to resolve PC operational issues efficiently.
 - Diagnosed and resolved operating system crashes, application glitches, network configuration faults, driver issues, etc with minimal user downtime.
 - Guided personnel through system configurations and software workflows, maintaining high incident-resolution rates and smooth operational continuity.

projects.title: Printer Hardware & Network Printing Support
projects.bodyText:
- Configured and deployed desktop and shared network printers across departments, establishing stable LAN/IP print server connections.
 - Diagnosed and resolved hardware faults, paper jams, print spooler crashes, driver conflicts, and connectivity issues promptly to minimize workflow disruptions.
 - Performed scheduled head cleaning, alignment calibrations, and toner/ink cartridge replacements to maintain high print quality and prolong hardware lifespan.
